messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for inference-runtime v2.7.1 -> 5% traffic to west1-canary
maya_ops: seeing a small spike in 500s for canary; anyone else?
jordan_sre: I see it too, 5xx rate ~3% in the last 2m. Not on prod routes.
maya_ops: paging oncall @sam_oncall
ops-incidents-bot: PAGER: sam_oncall has been paged for HIGH canary-error-rate
sam_oncall: on it. checking logs and dashboards
sam_oncall: hm dashboard link 404 for canary-service metrics ?
eli_prod: that's expected — we moved dashboards to new observability workspace last week, forgot to update the canary links
sam_oncall: great. so alert rule probably still pointed at old metric namespace
jordan_sre: alert query snippet:
```
increase(errors_total{service="inference-runtime-canary"}[5m]) / increase(requests_total{service="inference-runtime-canary"}[5m]) > 0.02
```
jordan_sre: but metric is now tagged as service_name with different label, so noise/false positives
maya_ops: that explains why the alert didn't show on the new dashboard and why routing misfired
sam_oncall: I can stop the rollout and flip the kill-switch if customer impact > 0.2% across global
eli_prod: customer-facing errors are limited to ~60 requests/min from one region; not global yet
sam_oncall: initiating manual canary pause: /rollout pause --canary inference-runtime v2.7.1
deploy-bot: Canary paused by sam_oncall at 1815028005
maya_ops: thanks. let's also mute the noisy alert until we fix rule
sam_oncall: muting alert for 1h, adding todo to fix label mapping
ops-incidents-bot: Incident created INC-2026-347: 'Canary error alert misrouted after metrics rename' assigned to jordan_sre
jordan_sre: I'll update the alert to use `service_name` and re-run rule against historical data
eli_prod: also need a redirect on the dashboard links and a playbook note so next deploy doesn't break this
maya_ops: handoff: sam_oncall taking over for next 30m while I jump on customer thread
sam_oncall: taking handoff. leaving notes:
- paused canary
- alerted alerts muted
- incident INC-2026-347 created
- next: patch alert, restore dashboard link, resume canary only after smoke tests
maya_ops: @customer-success looping in affected tenants; no widespread customer SLO burn detected but monitoring closely :eyes:
sam_oncall: will follow up with a postmortem if root cause is the label rename and missing rollout checklist
maya_ops: thanks all. closing thread after monitoring stabilizes :thumbsup:
